title: StackConnection
description: One connection the Stack manages (STACK-CONNECTIONS-01): a paired Home (kind `home`) or a custom MCP server the household added (kind `mcp`). The Stack owns the record; Home shows the same list and forwards every action. A `home` record carries a key fingerprint, never key material. An `mcp` record carries where it starts or lives, the tools it offers once tested, and `secret_ref`, an opaque name for a token kept in the Stack's secrets store; the token's value is never in this record or any reply. Who may call which tool stays in Home's age and surface gates.

reach.description: How it reaches the Stack (home: this_computer, home_network or tailscale) or how the Stack reaches it (mcp: command or url).

state.description: `not_tested` is an mcp record the Stack has not been able to start yet (the Stack does not run MCP servers in this phase).

last_seen_at.description: A home: the last request the Stack admitted from it.

last_used_at.description: An mcp: the last tool call it served.

key_fingerprint.description: A home: the fingerprint of its public key. Null until the pairing helper reports it.

endpoint.description: An mcp: how it starts or where it is.

tools.description: An mcp: the tools the server offers, read from it by Test. Empty until then.

secret_ref.description: An mcp: the name of its token in the Stack's secrets store. Never the value.
